what_this_is: The data contract for the hustle-index commission board. Every commission posted to the community follows this shape. Plain JSON, no database server (ADR-005), validated by build.yml on every push.

the_deal.who_can_post: Any brother who has completed at least one sandbox blueprint rung and posted a DAP in the last 30 days. No gatekeeping on level — gatekeeping on receipts.
the_deal.who_can_take: Any brother. First to comment 'I'm on it' in the issue thread holds the ticket for 48 hours. If no update in 48, the ticket reopens. One commission at a time per brother — finish before you flex.
the_deal.the_split: 100% to the brother who ships it. FED-EDU takes nothing. The community exists to move money INTO Black households, not through our hands.
the_deal.conflict_rule: Two brothers want the same ticket? The client picks. No beef in the thread — take the loss like a pro, watch how the winner runs it, take the next one. There's always a next one.

rate_floors_reminder.one_pager: $150 minimum. Client gets a single-page site, deployed, one revision round.
rate_floors_reminder.multi_page: $500 minimum for 3+ pages with nav. Deployed, two revision rounds.
rate_floors_reminder.retainer: $50/month maintenance floor. Hosting checks, content edits, uptime eyes.
rate_floors_reminder.never_do_this: Undercut another brother to steal a ticket. That's the one move that gets you benched from the board. The floors are the floor BECAUSE they protect all of us. When one brother works for $40, the client learns to offer $40 to everybody.
rate_floors_reminder.source: PRICING.md in the repo root — the floors are community law, not suggestions.

id.note: Date of posting plus a two-digit sequence. The poster makes it up; build.yml checks uniqueness.

status.note: The poster updates this field in their PR. 'paid' requires a delivery receipt screenshot (amount redacted).

service_type.note: fix-rescue = brother's existing site is broken and they need it saved. custom = anything else, described in the brief.

client_type.note: internal-fed-edu = work for the community itself (this site, tools, flyers). Also paid — community work is REAL work.

brief.note: What the client needs, in their words if possible. No jargon required — the hustle market speaks plain.

budget_floor.note: The CLIENT's minimum acceptable budget. Must meet or beat the community rate floor for the service type. build.yml rejects lower.

timeline_days.note: Calendar days from claim to delivery. Be honest — the rung ladder taught you your real speed.

posted_by.note: GitHub handle of the brother posting. This is a REFERRAL board too — brothers bring client leads from their own networks.

claimed_by.note: GitHub handle of the brother on the ticket. null while open.

skills_needed.note: Map to the courses-and-guides names so newer brothers can see which course unlocks which ticket.

raffle_credit.note: Tickets for shipping this commission. Same scale as blueprints: 5 for a fix, 10 for a small ship, 15 for a full build, 20 for a repeat client.

the_flow.1_post: Brother with a client lead posts the commission as an issue using the hustle_spawn template + this schema in the PR.
the_flow.2_claim: First brother comments 'I'm on it'. Poster updates claimed_by. 48-hour clock starts.
the_flow.3_ship: Claimer posts progress in the thread (DAP counts). Delivers deployed URL + handoff file.
the_flow.4_confirm: Client happy -> poster flips status to delivered, then paid once the money clears.
the_flow.5_receipts: Both brothers post a one-line receipt in the thread (no amounts, no client names). This feeds the leaderboard tally.
the_flow.6_repeat: Client comes back? That's a retainer conversation ($50/mo floor) and +5 raffle credit for the brother who kept them.

integrity_rules: No commission is a scam shield: if a client refuses to pay, the community blacklists THE CLIENT (we keep a private list), not the brother.
Poster referral cuts are fine IF declared in the thread up front. Hidden cuts are a benchable offense — the board runs on trust.
FED-EDU is not a party to any contract. Brothers are independent operators. The board is a meeting place, not an employer. (Read GOVERNANCE.md.)
Never quote below the floors 'to get started'. Every below-floor quote teaches clients our work is cheap. It isn't.
Under-18 brothers take commissions with a guardian cc'd on the thread. No exceptions — protecting the young kings is law.
